Philippines 2022 · Singapore 2024–25

Situation
The group needed working offices in the Philippines and Singapore, plus housing for the staff moving with them.
What I did
Sourced the sites, chose the premises, planned layouts, and ran fit-out, furniture, equipment and procurement through to opening. Found and furnished staff accommodation.
Result
Both offices opened ready to work, on capital budgets of US$300,000 and US$500,000.

Cambodia & Southeast Asia · 2021–2026

Situation
A Confidential clientregional group with staff from many countries, and leadership that needed HR to simply work.
What I did
Year one: the full HR and admin scope. Then the Philippines office launch. Then four years as the group's sole HR business partner: recruitment, payroll, appraisals, foreign work permits, confidential records and the SOPs.
Result
In four years, no foreign employee lost a working day to a lapsed permit. One trusted contact for about 1,000 employees, in Mandarin and English.

A technical publication was going out in English, Traditional Chinese, Malay, Japanese, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese.

GOGOTEL Hospitality · 2016–2019

Situation
A short-stay portfolio of more than 200 properties, with guests, owners and site teams who all needed answers fast.
What I did
Travelled between sites to run check-ins, turnarounds and on-site fixes. Managed housekeeping and security standards, HR, sales, finance and booking channels.

Every incident answered within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day, for three and a half years.
